title: Original reference
summary: Listen to the unchanged source before evaluating any derived recording.
warning: No enhancement is performed by this web companion.

title: Low-frequency rumble
summary: Proposed starting chain for low-frequency environmental noise.
warning: Reference only. Filtering can remove speech information; compare with the original.

title: Mains hum review
summary: Inspect 50 Hz and 60 Hz components before choosing a narrow notch.
warning: Reference only. Hum frequency is not selected automatically.

title: Speech review
summary: Proposed conservative listening chain for manual speech review.
warning: Reference only. Frequency limits do not establish that speech is present.

title: Acquisition record
summary: Record origin, collector, acquisition method, date/time with timezone, original filename and SHA-256.
warning: Keep the original separately. A hash alone does not establish origin or chain of custody.

title: Processing record
summary: Document parent and output hashes, software version, complete parameters and the purpose of each operation.

title: Transcript review
summary: Preserve uncertainty and record reviewer corrections separately from model output.
warning: Do not convert model scores into factual certainty or invent confidence scores.

title: Export handoff
summary: Bundle original references, derived artifacts, provenance records and a verifier; independently verify before transfer.
warning: This development build exports a basic intake manifest only.
